description: This source file provides utility functions and procedures for managing runtime dependencies of plugins within a build or deployment process. It includes functions for reading and writing JSON files, manipulating directories, resolving dependencies, staging node modules, and installing dependencies via npm with retries. The main exported function, 'stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps', orchestrates staging runtime dependencies for bundled plugins found in specific directories.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from disk given its file path.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript object to JSON and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory or file at a given path if it exists.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory inside a parent directory with a specified prefix.

methods.name: sanitizeTempPrefixSegment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as part of a temporary directory prefix.

methods.name: replaceDir
methods.description: Replaces a target directory with a source directory, copying contents if across devices.

methods.name: dependencyNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency within node_modules based on dependency name.

methods.name: readInstalledDependencyVersion
methods.description: Reads the installed version of a dependency from its package.json.

methods.name: dependencyVersionSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if an installed dependency version satisfies a given semantic version specification.

methods.name: collectInstalledRuntimeClosure
methods.description: Recursively collects all dependencies and optional dependencies satisfying version constraints.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDirs
methods.description: Lists plugin directories under 'dist/extensions' that contain a package.json.

methods.name: hasRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Determines if a package.json declares dependencies or optional dependencies.

methods.name: shouldStageRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a package.json specifies that runtime dependencies should be staged.

methods.name: sanitizeBundledManifestForRuntimeInstall
methods.description: Removes 'openclaw' related peer and dev dependencies from a plugin's package.json.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDepsStampPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the runtime dependencies stamp file for a plugin.

methods.name: createRuntimeDepsFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash fingerprint of the package.json object.

methods.name: readRuntimeDepsStamp
methods.description: Reads the runtime dependencies stamp file, returning its contents if valid.

methods.name: stageInstalledRootRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Stages the runtime dependencies by copying node_modules from root to plugin, generating a stamp.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Installs runtime dependencies for a plugin via npm, staging the result.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDepsWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to install dependencies with retries on failure.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Main function that iterates over bundled plugins, staging their runtime dependencies if needed.
